source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Because several 3D models on the integrated board refer to libraries available only on your machine, a few components were absent when I opened the 3D viewer. Luka, could you send me the following three files?

northstar-asset-b12cb202.stp (from your Pebble.3dshapes library) — for USB1
northstar-asset-949a889b.step (from the JLCPCB plugin library) — for Q3
northstar-asset-46da1990.step (from the JLCPCB plugin library) — for S1

After receiving them, I'll place them in the project's libs/componentvault/componentvault.3dshapes/ folder. Thanks!
